newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore forex contracts extended due to holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore forex contracts extended due to holiday.

text.p: All contracts maturing on January 2, an unforeseen bank holiday in Singapore, will have to be extended to the next working day, the Singapore Foreign Exchange Market Committee said in statement.

"In the absence of prior arrangements or other agreements, banks should negotiate mutually acceptable interest rate adjustments," the statement said. Failing an agreement on an acceptable interest rate, the contracted rate should be used.
January 2 was only declared a public holiday in Singapore when the general election was called for that day on December 23. -- Singapore newsroom (65 870-3080)
